testPrecondition: Invocation deadline was created 100ms before descriptor serialization and the request call; no dispatch synchronization established that the request reached the wire.
productionBoundary: OpsAgentRagTool.requireRemaining rejects an already expired pre-dispatch deadline as PERMANENT; UNKNOWN is for an attempted call without a known result.
resolution: Test-only correction: construct descriptor/input and warm the same HTTP client before the measured call; use explicit server-entered and response-release latches; require dispatch before asserting UNKNOWN. Independently assert an already expired request is PERMANENT with no additional dispatch. No production code, deadline semantics, or accepted failure kinds were loosened.
